verdict.rationale: Fedora's own Workstation page makes this exact claim: "all the packages, tools and runtimes you might need, up to date and ready for use with just a single command" (fedora-docs-3). It is backed by documented package management, container tooling and a Container_Toolbox subvariant (fedora-docs-12, fedora-docs-13, fedora-docs-18). One user report of turning a fresh install into a full Python development workstation quickly (fedora-comm-8) loosely corroborates it. The evidence stays at marketing level and never names the command or shows how it works. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the specific single-command workflow (which command, which toolchains and runtimes), and independent hands-on confirmation that a developer environment comes up with one command.
